summary: A playable Farestorm vertical slice: drive one of three storm cabs around the procedural coastal city of Galeport, pick up and deliver passengers against a shift clock, chain drifts/near-misses/shortcuts into Pulse tips, and finish with a ranked results screen in Arcade, Quick or Time Trial mode.
notes: No external assets; everything is procedural. Skill School, ghosts, leaderboard, Rapier/Babylon and key remapping are not built. Real-GPU frame rate and audio were not verified (headless software GL only). ?bot=1 and ?autostart=... are verification aids, not game features.
